name: Radama I
contribution: The first Malagasy sovereign to be recognized as King of Madagascar by a European state, Great Britain.
legacy: Through aggressive military campaigns, he successfully united two-thirds of the island under his rule.

checks.lead: Radama I (c. 1793–1828), also known as Radama the Great, was the first Malagasy sovereign to be recognized as King of Madagascar (1810–1828) by a European state, Great Britain. He came to power at the age of 17 following the death of his father, King Andrianampoinimerina.
checks.photo: no death year in or after 1860
